honest_c3: Eval limit=200 (per spec) gives stderr ~3.5pp on HellaSwag/TriviaQA and ~1.0pp on MMLU; this is wider than the v3 spec limit=500 used for parity floors (~2pp HS/TQ, ~0.4pp MMLU). RE-VERDICT calls within 1-σ of parity threshold are noise-bounded.

Llama-base anchors (0.654 / 0.5796 / 0.396) were measured at limit=500 single seed=42 (BG-O 93bef8c8). This eval-rerun uses limit=200 — comparing limit=200 LoRA value against limit=500 base value introduces sample-set mismatch beyond stderr (different problems sampled). Strict apples-to-apples would re-measure base at limit=200 same seed; deferred for cost.

transformers>=4.51 pin upgrades from retry-3 train-time transformers~4.45-4.49; LoRA adapter was trained against the OLDER transformers config. Re-loading via PEFT into newer transformers MAY produce subtle activation drift if config keys differ. Smoke test catches gross failures but not subtle numeric drift.

Re-eval consumes adapter weights as-is — does NOT re-train. If forgetting was caused by training-time issues (LR, schedule, mix), re-eval cannot fix it; only EXPOSE it. Conversely if v3 verdict was eval-pipeline artifact only, re-eval fully resolves it.

Pre-eval PEFT smoke test (added L14) loads base+adapter+forward pass; this catches dtype kwarg and adapter structural issues at <30s of $2.99/hr cost (~$0.025) instead of failing at minute 5+ across 3 benches.

Re-eval verdict re-uses retry-3 spec parity/improvement thresholds (-1pp HS/MM, -2pp TQ floor; +2pp improve); these are same as retry-3 — methodologically clean. Only the limit=200 vs limit=500 stderr asymmetry is novel.

Forgetting_index is a 3-bench mean fractional drop; treats benchmarks as equally weighted. Real-world salience may differ (TriviaQA more knowledge-heavy than HellaSwag commonsense) — interpret as scalar summary not as singular evidence.

v3 conservatively coded eval=null as F3=FAIL because it could not distinguish (a) adapter is broken from (b) measurement was broken. This rerun assumes (b) and tests (a) directly; an UNDERESTIMATE result here is INFORMATIVE about both v3 forgetting status AND measurement-pipeline reliability.
Single-seed (42) eval; no multi-seed bootstrap on RE-VERDICT — point estimate only.
Pod budget cap $5 leaves <30min margin if smoke test or downloads stall; spec target is $1-3 / 30-45min so cap is generous but not unbounded — monitor cost/min in run.log.
